svg.title: ArchFlow V4 Phase-Gated Design Reasoning, Dual State, and Single-Writer Commit Architecture
svg.desc: A continuous three-part chain: raw requirements, commitments, and brief compilation form D_v,0. D_v,k advances through a non-skippable design-maturity graph. The current phase, obligations, and evidence dynamically discover experts allowed in that phase. The Primary Architect's natural-language design move first compiles into an exact-base typed operator and State Delta; precondition checks, bindings, application, named-dependency closure, and verifiable observations produce D_v,k+1. Schematic design must precede design development, which must precede candidate assembly. Backward revision invalidates affected downstream deliverables and creates new obligations. Only an execution-ready D_v,k may become a Candidate Submission. Hard gates, commitment monitoring, and readonly aesthetic evaluation remain separate before the single writer creates a commit event and the versioned State Reducer forms C_v+1. C_v, D_v,k, and the append-only evidence trace H remain distinct.
svg.text: ARCHFLOW V4 · COMPILE INTENT → EVOLVE DESIGN STATE → SUBMIT CANDIDATE → VALIDATE → SINGLE-WRITER COMMIT
OPEN DESIGN PATH · EVIDENCED TRANSITIONS · ONE FORMAL WRITER
① COMPILE REQUIREMENTS / COMMITMENTS / BRIEF → D_v,0
RAW EVIDENCE + CURRENT AUTHORITY → BRANCH-LOCAL SUFFICIENT DESIGN STATE
Interpret users and activities; preserve ambiguity and provenance
Derive functions, capacities, area ranges, and relations
Given dimensions → commitments; omitted dimensions → design results
No hard-coded 16×12, topology, or Pack answer
Plus evaluations, unknowns, phase outputs, and budget for the next move
Incomplete or branched; no canonical write authority
Only compiled or observed facts enter state
Inspect functions, areas, relations, and rationale
Preview, relocate, revise, pause, or undo
Preference and final approval remain human authority
② DESIGN LOOP: D_v,k → ARCHITECT → TYPED OPERATOR → CLOSURE → D_v,k+1
ORDERED PHASE GATES · DYNAMIC EXPERTS WITHIN THE CURRENT PHASE
NO FORWARD SKIP · EXPERTS CANNOT SELF-CERTIFY PHASE COMPLETION
BACKWARD REVISION → INVALIDATE DOWNSTREAM DELIVERABLES + NEW OBLIGATIONS · D_v,k RECORDS PHASE + EXACT-BASE OUTPUTS

State-responsive experts allowed in this phase
PHASE ∩ D_v,k ∩ OBLIGATIONS ∩ EVIDENCE · READ ONLY
program / capacity / site / structure / circulation / material…
Dynamic order · reject cross-phase output · advice is not command
CLI · MCP · MODEL · STORAGE · NO ARCHITECTURAL AUTHORITY

TOOL SUCCESS ≠ USABILITY · cannot waive hard gates or advance C_v

svg.text: ZOOM: SEMANTIC–REALIZATION BRIDGE BETWEEN ARCHITECT AND TYPED OPERATOR
ONE DECISION, COMMON SOURCE · PLATFORM EXECUTION HAS NO ACCEPTANCE AUTHORITY
geometry object id ↔ platform object id
STRUCTURED SCENE STATE = AUTHORITY · SCREENSHOT = READONLY EVIDENCE · PLATFORM EXECUTION ≠ ACCEPTANCE

g.text: ③ OUTER LOOP: EXECUTION READY → CANDIDATE REVIEW → SINGLE WRITER → C_v+1
HARD / COMMITMENT / SOFT STAY DISTINCT · ONE CANONICAL WRITER
exact base C_v + final D_v,k digest
Only entry from working design into formal review
proportion / rhythm / space / material / preference; cannot waive hard failure
Soft scores cannot cover hard failure
EXECUTION-READY D_v,k ONLY · ARCHITECT DECLARES CANDIDATE
HARD / COMMITMENT FINDING → EVIDENCE-BOUND OBLIGATION → D_v,k · ARCHITECT CHOOSES REPAIR
PROMPTS · RETRIEVAL · PROPOSALS · OBSERVATIONS · REJECTS · COMMITS
audit / attribution / training / recovery; do not stuff the full transcript into D_v,k
state rebuild ≠ external MCP / LLM execution replay
Validate event order, version, digest, and commitment lifecycle
Verifiable state rebuild without claiming execution replay
The only formal baseline for the next design branch
C_v authority remains separate from branch-local D_v,k
C_v = CANONICAL AUTHORITY · D_v,k = BRANCH-LOCAL DESIGN STATE · H≤t = AUDIT TRACE · PROPOSAL ≠ FACT · TOOL SUCCESS ≠ USABILITY · SOFT ≠ HARD
